title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin decouples from central bank constraints as the Clarity Act removes approval barriers and the Fed stays sidelined on rate hikes. Price closed at 77,833, up 3.2 percent, holding support near 75,000 with Fear and Greed at 71. 

Marty Bent has flagged the Fed's limited room to maneuver higher. Andreas Antonopoulos has detailed how the halving subsidy cut meets stronger infrastructure this cycle. Unchained has emphasized Bitcoin's fixed supply and node consensus, blocking any hidden dilution
